    date_format: number | string;
    resources: number | string;
}> & CbsControls;

// @public

    resources: number | string;
}> & CbsControls;

export type CbsSportLeaguesParams = RequiredParam<"sport_id", number | string> & CbsControls;

}> & CbsControls;

}> & CbsControls;

}> & CbsControls;

};

// @public
export type RecruitingYearParams = OptionalParams<{
    ranking_key: number | string;
}> & RecruitingControls;

// @public
export function registerFamilyDefaults(family: string, defaults: FamilyDefaults): void;

// @public
export type ReleaseColumns = Record<string, unknown[]>;

// @public
export interface ReleaseLoaderOptions {
    columns?: string[];
    format?: "rows" | "columns";
    maxCells?: number;
    timeoutMs?: number;
}

// @public
export type ReleaseRow = Record<string, unknown>;

// @public
export const RELEASES_FAMILY = "releases";

// @public
export type RequiredParam<K extends string, V> = K extends SnakeToCamel<K> ? {
    [P in K]: V;
} : ({
    [P in K]: V;
} & {
    [P in SnakeToCamel<K>]?: V;
}) | ({
    [P in K]?: V;
} & {
    [P in SnakeToCamel<K>]: V;
});

// @public
export function resetConfig(): void;

// @public
export function resolveFlat(def: WrapperDef, params?: Record<string, any>): {
    url: string;
    query: Record<string, any>;
};

// @public
export function resolvePffApiKey(apiKey?: string): string | undefined;

// @public
export type Row = Record<string, unknown>;

// @public
export type Scope = "universal" | "ncaa" | "football" | "mlb";

// @public
export type Sdv = MergeNamespaces<MergeNamespaces<GeneratedNamespaces, LegacyNamespaces>, HandWrittenNamespaces>;

// @public
const sdv: Sdv;
export default sdv;

// @public (undocumented)
export interface SdvConfig {
    // (undocumented)
    auth: Record<string, AuthProvider>;
    // (undocumented)
    retries: number;
    // (undocumented)
    timeoutMs: number;
    // (undocumented)
    transport: Record<string, Transport>;
    // (undocumented)
    userAgent: string;
}

// @public
export class SdvError extends Error {
    constructor(message: string, options?: {
        cause?: unknown;
    });
}

// @public
export interface SeasonLoader {
    // (undocumented)
    (opts: SeasonLoaderOptions & {
        format: "columns";
    }): Promise<ReleaseColumns>;
    // (undocumented)
    (opts: SeasonLoaderOptions): Promise<ReleaseRow[]>;
}

// @public
export interface SeasonLoaderOptions extends ReleaseLoaderOptions {
    seasons: number | number[];
}

// @public
export class SeasonNotFoundError extends SdvError {
}

// @public
export interface SectionedWrapper<P = Row[], S extends object = {}, A extends object = WrapperParams> {
    <K extends keyof S & string>(params: A & {
        parsed: true;
        section: K;
    }): Promise<S[K]>;
    (params: A & {
        parsed: true;
        section: string;
    }): Promise<Row[]>;
    (params: A & {
        parsed: true;
    }): Promise<P>;
    (...params: ParamsArg<A & {
        parsed?: boolean;
        section?: string;
    }>): Promise<unknown>;
}

// @public
export type SnakeToCamel<S extends string> = S extends `${infer H}_${infer C}${infer T}` ? `${H}${Uppercase<C>}${SnakeToCamel<T>}` : S;

    // (undocumented)

    query?: Record<string, unknown>;
    responseType?: "json" | "text" | "arraybuffer";
    // (undocumented)
    timeoutMs?: number;
    url: string;
}

    // (undocumented)
    data: unknown;
    headers: Record<string, string>;
    // (undocumented)
    status: number;
    url: string;
}

}

// @public
export interface Wrapper<P = Row[], A extends object = WrapperParams> {
    (params: A & {
        parsed: true;
    }): Promise<P>;
    (...params: ParamsArg<A & {
        parsed?: boolean;
    }>): Promise<unknown>;
}

// @public
export interface WrapperDef {
    api?: string;
    auth?: boolean;
    deprecated?: string;
    family?: EspnFamily;
    fixedParams?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
    flat?: boolean;
    host?: string;
    includePrefixes?: string[];
    legacyShort?: string;
    nowToggle?: string;
    nowVariant?: string;
    parser?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    path: string;
    // (undocumented)
    pathParams: PathParam[];
    publicName?: string;
    publicShort?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    queryParams: QueryParam[];
    returnsSchema?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    scope: Scope;
    short: string;
}

// @public
export type WrapperFn = (params?: any) => Promise<any>;

// @public
export type WrapperParams = {
    [param: string]: unknown;
};

// @public (undocumented)
export const WRAPPERS: WrapperDef[];
